attBesluta.text: I love these, I got two and they are incredible. Really high quality and so nice to walk on. Very easy to store as well. Might get more.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5 von 5 Sternen – 1A, geruchsfrei, top verarbeitet, volle Empfehlung Die Vivo Tatami-Matte ist wirklich 1A. Ich kann mich absolut nicht beschweren: Sie stinkt nicht, hält genau das, was sie verspricht, und wirkt sehr hochwertig verarbeitet. Das Material ist voll Bambus, sauber verarbeitet und macht insgesamt einen stabilen Eindruck. Ich nutze die Matte jetzt seit vier Wochen und kann bisher keine Mängel entdecken. Praktisch ist auch, dass sie faltbar ist – ich kann sie problemlos zum Lüften aufstellen. Bis jetzt ein hervorragendes Produkt – klare Kaufempfehlung.

So beautiful… If you feel a bit too ‘contained’ on a yoga mat then this is a perfect alternative. It feels and looks beautiful and folds away nicely, very well made, and is a joy to stretch on and use. Highly recommend. I will comment on my delivery however, it was not delivered to me… I found it dropped off at the UPS station after some hunting, and that wasn’t clear at all in the note I was left. Nobody tried to call me to deliver if that was the issue.

I love this cart. It is very durable easy to roll and very spacious. Easy to put together, I use it for taking items in the office. My laptops, cords, and screens fit perfect. My back is relieved from the tension of my laptop bag.
my only complaint is that the handle could be longer, but otherwise I love this cart, especially for going up and down stairs. I don’t worry about it breaking.
Beautiful cart perfect for any teacher. Loved the wheels made it easier for me to get on the sidewalk. The 360 wheels made it easier for me to control at school.

No issues with this one. I have looked at others. I originally found one on Walmart and bought it there and wanted another one, but they were out. I found this one here and grabbed it before it was gone. It holds a lot and has a cell phone holder. I use them for all of my paint supplies and easels when teaching a paint and sip class. The paint bottles are very heavy and I have had no issues with the durability of the container or the wheels or any other part of it and some of the other makers seem to have; from reviews I have read. The only issue is I wish it came in other colors, but I like the pink.

I wanted this for school, and I wanted all wheels to move 360. But the back wheels are very hard to work with. And I don’t even have that many stairs! I wish the wheels were 360, and, even though pink is my favorite color, I think they should have more color options. The quality is top notch though! Recommend if you don’t mind non 360 wheels, and you love the color pink!

Het wagentje is opzich goed voor trappen omhoog. Maar trappen omlaag is moeilijk. Het past een stofzuiger en een klein mandje makkelijk in het wagentje. Rechte trap is goed te doen, wenteltrappen helaas niet.
It's not very durable can't put much stuff in it without it wobbling everywhere and wheels go wherever they want hard to roll around the super cute concept and color

I love this artificial grass! Once I mapped out the layout of my side yard, and what I wanted to do with it, I was able to cut it, lay it over weed barrier, and hammer stakes to set it to the ground. As you can see from the "before" photo below, it's a tremendous difference. It stops the dogs from tracking dirt in the house also. I don't know how it will get through the seasons, but I love it so far. The only thing I would change would be to make the color a little darker green.
Very sturdy platform. I use it to mount a vice on and it works perfectly.
